scoring_justification: Recomputing the full DFT DOS from scratch is infeasible in the verifier; we audit structural features: occupied Hf-defect peak within the MoS2 band gap and Fermi-level pinning at the CBM.

outputs.description: Atom-projected density of states for the defective MoS2-HfO2 system with an O vacancy. The checker will locate the MoS2 band gap from total_DOS, verify the presence of an occupied Hf-derived state within the gap, and confirm that the Fermi level (0 eV) is at or above the conduction band minimum (n-type pinning).

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the VBM and CBM from the total_DOS, then check for a peak in Hf_DOS (and total_DOS) at energy <0 eV within the gap, and assess Fermi level alignment. Structural features are scored with tolerance ±0.2 eV for the defect peak position to allow for method differences. No absolute energy values are required to match the paper.

steps.notes: Structural audit: occupied Hf-defect peak + n-type pinning
